title: Lesson 6: Activity Management
keyConcepts: Email Signals and staying on top of automated reminders
nextTeaser: Next up: using AI alongside Zoho — Zia's built-in assistant and Claude, connected directly to our CRM.

blocks.html: In this lesson, we cover the daily habits that keep our "Source of Truth" alive: the correct way to log your interactions and manage your tasks.

1. The Golden Rule: Log Everything

At OneAccord, we have a simple rule of thumb: "If it isn't in Zoho, it didn't happen." Our system relies on accurate history to ensure that if a Principal is away, another can step in seamlessly. You are expected to log:

  • Meetings: Summary of what was discussed and next steps.
  • Calls: Brief notes on the outcome of the conversation.
  • Notes: General observations or important context about a Contact or Company.

blocks.label: Find it now
blocks.instructions: Open any Contact record. Look at the left-hand menu for Notes, Activities, and Closed Activities. This is where the entire history of that relationship lives.

2. Managing Your Tasks

Automations will frequently create tasks for you to keep records from going stale, but the most successful Principals also drive their own schedule.

  • Automated Tasks: These are system-generated "To-Do" items to ensure we don't drop the ball on process.
  • Self-Created Follow-ups: You are expected to create manual follow-up tasks for yourself for anything you want to track within an account. If you tell a client "I'll check back in three weeks," create that task immediately so it doesn't live in your head.
  • Closing Tasks: Once you complete an action, you must mark the task as "Closed." This stops the automation from nudging you further and keeps your dashboard clean.

blocks.label: Find it now
blocks.instructions: Click on the Tasks module in your sidebar. Switch the view to "My Open Tasks." Try creating a "Test Follow-up" task for yourself now using the plus (+) button.

3. Automation & Notifications

Because we have built-in workflows, you don't always have to remember the next step — Zoho will remind you.

  • Email Signals: When a client opens an email you sent from Zoho, you'll see a "Signal" (the bell icon) pop up in real-time.
  • Stale-record reminders: If a record sits untouched for too long, you may get an automated email reminder to check in and update it.

blocks.prompt: Where should you look to see the full history of interactions with a client?
options: The Timeline and Activities sections within their Contact or Company record
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct — the Timeline and Activities sections within their Contact or Company record hold the full interaction history.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: It's the Timeline and Activities sections within their Contact or Company record — that's where the entire relationship history lives.

options: Set a reminder on your phone instead
Wait for an automated nudge to fire
Ask Zia to remember it for you
Manually create a follow-up task for yourself in the Company or Contact record
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct — create a manual follow-up task for yourself so it doesn't just live in your head.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: You should manually create a follow-up task for yourself in the Company or Contact record, rather than relying on memory or automation alone.

blocks.prompt: True or False: Marking a task as "Closed" is necessary to stop automated nudges.
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Right — closing a task stops the automation from continuing to nudge you and keeps your dashboard clean.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Actually, this is True — marking a task "Closed" stops the automated nudges and keeps your dashboard clean.
